root:
(?sx)
                 (.+?)               # anything, followed by:
                 (?:
                  (?<=\n)(?=[%#]) |  # an eval or comment line
                  (?=</?[%&]) |      # a substitution or block or
                                     # call start or end
                                     # - don't consume
                  (\\\n) |           # an escaped newline
                  \Z                 # end of string
                 )
